interface.title: Swiss Influenza Monitor (v1.3.1)
interface.field: Public health / infectious disease epidemiology (influenza surveillance)
interface.stage_of_work: Monitoring and exploratory analysis of weekly surveillance data
interface.what_it_is_for: A Streamlit dashboard of the Swiss Federal Office of Public Health's weekly influenza data: it shows how incidence is moving now and lets you look back over past seasons by canton, age, sex and virus type, with adjustable look-back windows and color thresholds.

data.note: With no network, the sidebar shows '⚠️ Historical data fallback' (Data Version 20261021, downloaded 2026-10-25 17:34, reference date 2026-10-30). The bundled pickle runs from 2012-12-31 to 2026-10-12, so the newest data point is about 2.5 weeks before the reference date. All pages share session state: thresholds, look-back window, target date and colors carry over between pages.

features.name: Region tile map with adjustable color ceiling
features.general: Show one value per region on a tile map and set the top of the color scale, so regions above a chosen level saturate and stand out; switch between normalized rate and raw count
features.specific: Swiss canton hex map with an 'Upper Color Threshold' vertical slider and an Incid/Count outcome switch; hover a hexagon to read its value. Used on Latest status and, as a paired incidence/count pair, on History CNT
steps: choose Incid or Count
read the canton hex map values
drag the Upper Color Threshold slider down to flag cantons above that level
hover a hexagon to read its exact value
serves_tasks: Find the regions with the highest current values and flag those above a level
Compare rate and count maps for a past high-incidence period, rescale colors so differences show, and note when the scale's ceiling is too low
Switch between a population-normalized rate and raw counts

features.name: Look-back window linked to summary panels
features.general: Pick how many recent periods to include; a trend chart shows the window as a shaded band, and the map and subgroup bars show averages over that window
features.specific: Vertical 'Weeks to look back' slider (1–20) drives the recent-weeks line chart, the shaded band on the one-year chart, the canton hex map and the subgroup bar charts; too short a window gives a 'Time window too recent' message
steps: drag the Weeks to look back slider
check the shaded band on the one-year chart
read the averaged canton map and subgroup bars
widen the window if the 'too recent' message appears
serves_tasks: Choose how many recent periods to average over
Compare subgroups over the chosen window
See the latest national rate and whether it is rising or falling

features.name: Timeline period picker with overview band driving linked views
features.general: Choose the end date and length of a past window on a long overview time series; the window is drawn as a band on the overview and drives the linked views below it
features.specific: History CNT: 'Avg wind. (weeks)' pills (1–20) plus a 'Target date' slider over a 2013–2026 overview chart; the grey band marks the window and the zoomed national line and the canton maps (see f1) follow it
steps: click a window-length pill
drag the Target date slider to a season (or step it a week with the arrow keys)
check the grey band on the overview
read the linked zoomed chart and maps for that window
serves_tasks: Choose a past window (end date and length) on a long timeline and see regional values for it
Put the most recent season against past seasons by comparing peak height and timing

features.name: Composition area plots with reliability cutoff and linked zoom
features.general: Show each subgroup's share of the total over time as stacked areas, only for periods whose total is above a chosen cutoff; zoom all panels together, hover for shares, hide categories from the legend
features.specific: History GRP: national incidence line plus relative-incidence stacked areas for age, sex and type A/B; the 'Cutoff on inc. to draw area' slider moves a dashed line and hides low-incidence periods; box-zoom applies to all panels; legend click hides a trace; double-click resets
steps: set the cutoff slider
drag a zoom box over one season
hover to read each subgroup's share
click a legend item to hide it
double-click to zoom back out
serves_tasks: See each subgroup's relative share across seasons
Hide periods where the totals are too low to trust
Zoom into one season and read the subgroup shares
Hide one subgroup and reset the view

features.name: App-wide series color palette editor
features.general: Set the color of each named data series in one place and have every chart in the app use it
features.specific: Colors page: hex color pickers for Line-All, Bar-Sex/Type/Age, Area-Female/Male, Type A/B and each age group; saved in the session and re-applied on all pages
steps: open a series' color picker
type a hex code or drag in the color field
close the picker
open another page to see the new color
serves_tasks: Change the color of a data series across all charts
